mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL y/y > 5.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth, increasing inflation expectations and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC for interaction term over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1700 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 1700 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC for signal in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals manufacturing contraction, indicating economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 104.0, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month signals strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime, simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.33% and CPI inflation above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.33 and CPIAUCSL y/y > 5.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth, increasing inflation expectations and triggering monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.
